title: Bank Q2 Results Preview: 22 Banks Ranked From Filings

beats.say: Bank Q2 results season starts with the business updates. Twenty two banks have filed theirs. Across them, loans grew a median twenty one percent. Deposits grew seventeen. And at nineteen of the twenty two, loans are growing faster than deposits.
beats.cap: Bank Q2 results season starts with the business updates. 22 banks have filed theirs. Across them, loans grew a median 21%. Deposits grew 17%. And at 19 of the 22, loans are growing faster than deposits.

cues: Bank Q2 results season starts with the business updates.

beats.say: A bank lends out the money it takes in as deposits. Divide loans by deposits and you get the credit deposit ratio. The higher it goes, the less room is left.
